articleBody:
Miami's premier culinary event is returning with expanded opportunities for food lovers seeking exceptional dining at steep discounts. Miami Spice Restaurant Month, in its 25th edition, will run from August 1 through September 30, 2026, offering three-course prix-fixe menus with a minimum of 30% savings across more than 300 participating restaurants throughout the Greater Miami area. According to Miami Curated, this year's program from The Greater Miami Convention & Visitors Bureau includes a new reserve tier, marking a significant evolution for the long-running promotion.

The initiative has grown substantially since its inception, becoming a signature summer dining tradition in South Florida. By bringing together hundreds of restaurants—from casual neighborhood spots to high-end fine dining establishments—Miami Spice creates an accessible entry point for residents and visitors to explore the region's diverse culinary landscape. The extended two-month window allows diners ample opportunity to sample menus they might otherwise consider, while the guaranteed 30% minimum discount makes premium dining experiences more attainable.

The introduction of a reserve tier represents a strategic refinement of the program's structure. Rather than offering a one-size-fits-all approach, the new tiered system allows restaurants to position themselves according to their concept and pricing strategy, while giving diners clear expectations about the caliber and style of dining experience they'll encounter. This flexibility likely encourages broader participation from establishments across the pricing spectrum.

For Miami's hospitality sector, Miami Spice has proven to be a powerful tool for driving traffic during the summer months, traditionally a slower period for tourism and dining. The program generates significant exposure for participating restaurants through coordinated marketing by the GMCVB, directing both local diners and visitors to discover new favorites. Many establishments report that the initial visit sparked by the promotion often converts into repeat customers who return at full price.

The 25th anniversary of the program underscores its resilience and relevance in an increasingly competitive dining market. As Miami continues to establish itself as a world-class culinary destination, initiatives like Miami Spice play an important role in democratizing access to quality restaurants and reinforcing the region's reputation for diverse, innovative cuisine. The participation of over 300 restaurants speaks to broad industry support and confidence in the event's drawing power.
